name: The Castle of Cinders
visual_description: A crumbled structure still smoldering, its spires intact but leaning. Fire blossoms like moss along the edges. It is not dead. Just quiet.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh stood here. I do not know if it burned this place—or if it *wept* here, and the heat was simply mourning. Either way, I sat in the ashes. I still do.
